name: Adni
long_description:
Healthcare employers tell Adni who they're hiring. Adni searches millions of healthcare workers across its own clinician network, proprietary data, external sources, and employer databases to identify the best candidates.

Recruiters can search and contact candidates themselves, or deploy Allie, Adni's AI recruiting agent, to continuously source, engage, screen, and surface interested candidates automatically.

Unlike traditional recruiting databases, Adni also operates a career community where healthcare workers find jobs, connect with peers, attend meetups, review facilities, and manage their careers, giving Adni a growing proprietary network of engaged clinicians.

Backed by YC, Flare Capital, Liquid 2, Fresco, Augment, Crista Galli, Adam Grant, the founders of CareRev, Clipboard Health, Papa, and more.
